## Approach
Adversarial mutation: free-form sequencing prose instead of the fixed structured keys — the
exact named regression architecture.md/resolver.md flags (issue #640): "`## Phases` uses fixed
structured keys, never free-form sequencing prose ... a prior free-form `## Sequencing` section
gave the resolver no way to recognize more phases were due." Here the heading is `## Phases` but
its body is unstructured prose instead of the numbered structured-key list.

## Phases
First we build the substrate, then the harness, then we get an operator sign-off, and finally we
write up the decision in a follow-up issue.
